question: Who among the following was an eminent scholar of Sanskrit, Hindi and Rajasthani alongside Persian, Arabic and Turki?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan court poet of Mughal emperor Akbar **was an eminent scholar of Sanskrit, Hindi and Rajasthani alongside Persian, Arabic and Turki.
 
• He was one of the nine important rank holders of **Navratnas **from the court of **Mughal emperor Akbar**.
 
• He was the son of **Bairam Khan mentor and guardian of Akbar**.
 
• He **translated Baburnama into Persian **and also wrote two astrology books in Sanskrit named **Khetakautukam, and Dwatrimshadyogavali.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Akbar** was the third **Mughal ruler of India.**
 
• **Birbal** was one of the top rank ministers of the court of Mughal emperor Akbar, he was part of **Navratna**.
 
• Ras Khan whose previous name was Syed Ibrahim Khan was a **Sufi Muslim **poet but later became the devotee of **Hindu God Lord Krishna.**
 
• Akbar was the third Mughal ruler of India.
